about: This release's own additions to the carried hostgen.json (release_carry.py merges them): each with why.

from_assembly.func_0034A870: src/pal/game/0034A870-cc.c declares its last callee, func_PAL_0034ABB0, void where its definition returns int: the inherited result does not compile
from_assembly.func_002CBD80: src/pal/game/002CBD80-g8.c declares func_PAL_0034ABB0 void too (as above)
from_assembly.func_L00_0037BEC8: src/pal/levels/shared/L00_0037BEC8-g8.c dispatches through a computed goto (goto *D_0026DBE0[...]), which hostgen does not translate

func_V1_L00_002B55F0_1.why: rac2-decomp's func_PAL_L00_002B5518 (src/pal/levels/shared/L00_002B5518-cc.c) is its PAL copy of func_L00_002B55F0, which the release table could not pair (the C calls it by its _1 spelling, which the release's build gave no value); call_copies.tsv pairs this caller's call with it in every level (func_L00_002B59B0 -> func_L00_002B5518 at level 0). Without it the hero's position history copies a stale ring entry over his position every tick and he falls to 0,0,0
